purpose: Dispatches reviewer-approved admin change requests to concrete domain services that mutate asset, category, and storefront data.
ownedConcepts: Dashboard request type to backend service mapping
businessRules: Pending requests are applied only when a reviewer approves them.
ARCHIVE performs temporary removal through soft status or inactive flags.
DELETE performs permanent row removal through explicit service delete methods.
Unsupported request type or action combinations fail approval with a structured admin change request error.
